objective_value: <float> Total profit from individual item profits plus pairwise profits of items sharing a knapsack.
assignment: <list[list[int]], shape [num_assigned_items][2]> List of [item_index, knapsack_index] pairs; item indices 0-indexed in [0, n-1] and knapsack indices 0-indexed in [0, m-1]. Unassigned items are omitted. An item index appearing more than once indicates a multi-assignment infeasibility (math_model label {assign}).
